text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………
I did it again……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Aaah, geez…… While overthinking things,
I just kept snacking……!
Even though I know I gain weight easily……!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……I have to do it……
A diet……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*…… That's 30 already……!
More than yesterday……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Move your body! Push yourself harder!
If I do that, the fat will—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-san?
Is that all you are having for lunch today?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah……
I'm already full, so……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Ugh…… My body feels……
heavier than usual……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because I skipped meals? But
if I eat a lot, I'll just gain weight again……)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Besides…… if I just keep this up, surely—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………Uuuugh……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(My approach is wrong……
At this rate, there's no way I can lose weight……)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……I-I have to change something……
I need to find…… the best way……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san…… She's always so stoic
and completely disciplined……)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(……Right! About dieting……
What if I tried asking her……?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(…………But she's in the middle of training.
If I talk to her…… I'll just be a nuisance, right……?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(B-Besides, someone like Duramente-san,
um…… wouldn't care about me anyway……)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I can't stay like this.
—Someone like me will never become anything.
It would be arrogant of me to even speak of dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(……I have to lose weight.
In that case—I have to take a step forward……!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………Um, e-excuse me!!
Duramente-shyan!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……I understand the situation.
Your approach itself isn't fundamentally wrong.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eh…… I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah…… Dietary restriction and muscle training
are both essential elements of dieting.
However, doing them blindly yields no results.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Can you show me how you were doing it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That won't engage the muscles properly.
Focus more on your form.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! ……Like this!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san is watching over me!
I have to work just as hard to match that……!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
H-How is it……?
If there's anything I'm doing poorly……
I-I'd appreciate it if you got mad at me……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No…… It's not bad.
You are earnest, and you take it seriously.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In a few days, you should return to your original weight.
—You have what it takes to accomplish that.

One day, I came across Cheval Grand and Duramente
talking together.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much……
Th-Thanks to you, I……
It's all thanks to you, Duramente-san……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……No. I merely lent a hand.
You are the one who produced the result.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all……! S-Someone like me……
shouldn't have gained weight in the first place……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……B-But.
Thank you very much……
